summary.text: Craig Riedel is the Republican nominee for Ohio Senate District 1 in the November 3, 2026 general election and a former state representative.
He represented Ohio House District 82 from 2017 to 2022.

paragraphs.text: Riedel graduated with a civil engineering degree from Ohio State University in 1988, according to Ballotpedia.
He worked as a design engineer and sales manager at Nucor Valcraft Group, a steel company, until retiring in 2015.
Riedel defeated incumbent Tony Burkley in the 2016 Republican primary for House District 82 and won the general election unopposed, taking office on January 1, 2017.
He served on the House Ways and Means Committee as vice chair in 2021-2022 and did not run for re-election in 2022.
He defeated James Hoops in the May 5, 2026 Republican primary for Senate District 1.
